contracts.fullName: deferred touch trigger (world-lifecycle-1) > clear() 原子复位未决 claim 与 deliveryFence：teardown 后 auto safe-point 屏障立即解除

contracts.fullName: AsyncIntentController capture (world-lifecycle-1) > capture() 是只读快照：不换代、不作废在途 token；后续 begin 才使旧 token 失效

contracts.oracle: 两次 capture 同 serial、在途 token 保持 current；新 begin 后旧 session/capture token 均失效并以原 message AbortError
